title: RunTerminated payload
description: The run was sent SIGTERM (a Kubernetes Job's deadline, a `systemctl stop`) before it ended, and stopped at the next safe point: a fetch or a model call in flight was ended. A gated run is undone (its stage abandoned, or its kept snapshot restored); an ungated run keeps the batches it applied, and a later run extracts the rest. Nothing about the source was wrong: the failure is not counted against it.
